senses.gloss: Own, one's own, relating to one-self, of one's own party or country; निजं वपुः पुन- रनयन्निजां रुचिम् Śi.17.4; R.3.15;18.27; Ms.2.5.
Continual, perpetual. -m. (pl.) One's own people. -Comp. -बोधः Self-knowledge, spiritual knowledge; भिक्षुर्न चाहं निजबोधरूपः Hastāmalaka Stotra.
To wash, cleanse, purify; सस्नुः पयः पपुरनेनिजुरम्बराणि Śi.5.28.
To wash or clean oneself, to be purified (Ā.).
To nourish. -With निस् to wash, clean, purify; तोयनिर्णिक्त- पाणयः R.17.22; Y.1.191; Ms.5.127.
